description: Get company guidance from written Item 2.02 earnings releases and earnings-call transcripts, newest release first, with range, unit, GAAP basis, fiscal period and source provenance. Closed target periods are marked ended. Revenue and diluted-EPS guidance includes the reported actual and verdict once comparable XBRL facts exist; non-GAAP guidance is never compared with GAAP actuals. Coverage notes distinguish unprocessed documents from sources that state no guidance.
name: GetGuidance
title: Company Guidance
